name: Destini Berhad
overview: 2026年，Destini Berhad 在 Mobility 板块签署了两项谅解备忘录：子公司 M Rail Technics 与 Siemens Mobility 探索合作建设铁路 MRO 可靠性控制中心，Destini Mobility 与 Zhejiang CRRC Electric Vehicle 就马来西亚电动巴士机会建立合作。同时，公司与 National Defence University of Malaysia 的谅解备忘录于2026年9月14日到期后不再续期。
overview_en: In 2026, Destini Berhad signed two memoranda of understanding in its Mobility segment: subsidiary M Rail Technics is exploring cooperation with Siemens Mobility to build a reliability control centre for rail MRO, and Destini Mobility entered into a partnership with Zhejiang CRRC Electric Vehicle on electric bus opportunities in Malaysia. Meanwhile, the company's MOU with National Defence University of Malaysia was not extended and expired on 14 September 2026.

segments.name: 移动业务
segments.note: 今年在铁路 MRO 和电动巴士领域分别签署合作谅解备忘录，探索新合作机会。
segments.note_en: This year the segment signed cooperation MOUs in rail MRO and electric buses to explore new collaboration opportunities.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 70%持股子公司 M Rail Technics 与 Siemens Mobility 签署谅解备忘录，探索合作建立用于数据驱动维护、维修和大修的铁路可靠性控制中心（RCC）。
actions.text_en: 70%-owned subsidiary M Rail Technics signed an MOU with Siemens Mobility to explore cooperation in establishing a Reliability Control Centre (RCC) for data-driven rail maintenance, repair and overhaul.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公司公告与 Zhejiang CRRC Electric Vehicle 的谅解备忘录截至2026年8月28日没有重大进展。
actions.text_en: The company announced that there was no material development as of 28 August 2026 on the MOU with Zhejiang CRRC Electric Vehicle.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 全资子公司 Destini Mobility 与 Zhejiang CRRC Electric Vehicle 签署谅解备忘录，合作开拓马来西亚公共交通领域的电动巴士机会。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Destini Mobility signed an MOU with Zhejiang CRRC Electric Vehicle to pursue electric bus opportunities in Malaysia's public transportation sector.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年与 National Defence University of Malaysia 的谅解备忘录到期后不再续期。
segments.note_en: This year the MOU with National Defence University of Malaysia was allowed to expire without extension.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 National Defence University of Malaysia 的谅解备忘录于2026年9月14日到期，公司决定不续期，该备忘录到期后失效。
actions.text_en: The MOU with National Defence University of Malaysia expired on 14 September 2026; the company decided not to extend it and the MOU ceased to have effect upon expiry.
